methodology.title: Methodology: How the SEPPA SSB-4D-AT PET Bottle Blowing Process Works
methodology.subtitle: The engineering journey of the SEPPA SSB-4D-AT begins with systematic multi preform loading, initiating a rigorously controlled PET bottle blowing process:

steps.title: Energy Optimized IR Heating
steps.description: This specific beverage packaging machine channels raw preforms through specialized, energy optimized IR heating modules, ensuring exact thermal profiling across all axes.

steps.title: Automated Transfer (AT) Loading
steps.description: Following optimal thermal conditioning, the advanced automated transfer (AT) mechanism seamlessly moves the heated preforms directly into the precision machined 4 cavity mold, utilizing high pressure pneumatics to achieve perfectly balanced material distribution.

steps.title: Stretch Blow & Automated Ejection
steps.description: By applying electronic pressure profiling during the stretch blow process, operators unequivocally guarantee structural integrity. Automated ejection swiftly removes finished containers, streamlining the workflow.
